display.purpose: Net worth, DCA monthly total. Financial hero figures only. Always tabular-nums.

headline.purpose: Page-level section totals. One level below the hero figure.

title.purpose: Section headings, modal titles, medium-scale card values (17–22px).

body.purpose: List row text, descriptions, form values. Inter only.

label.purpose: Captions, chip text, metadata below values, nav labels. Never all-caps.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Default card resting state. Ambient presence without drama.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover card state, open modal panel. Affordance signal for interactive surfaces.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Card reveal (rise) and modal sheet (sheetUp). Decelerates fast — feels responsive, not bouncy.

motion.name: ease-fade
motion.purpose: Modal backdrop fadeIn. Simple opacity transition.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Page card entrance animation on mount. Add reduced-motion override: instant show.

motion.name: sheetUp
motion.purpose: Modal panel entrance. Reduced-motion override: instant show.

motion.name: fadeIn
motion.purpose: Modal backdrop. Reduced-motion override: instant show.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.description: Modal switches from bottom sheet to centered dialog.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.description: Bottom nav hides; fixed sidebar appears.

narrative.overview:
Spendiary is a one-user, private financial cockpit. The interface speaks with quiet authority: every readout is calibrated, every element earns its presence. There is no decoration for its own sake. The design feels less like a consumer app and more like a well-engineered instrument — the kind that rewards repeated use and never demands attention it hasn't earned.

The density is deliberate but not punishing. The system surfaces real financial data on a calm, light-toned surface without the Bloomberg wall-of-numbers assault. Color is reserved exclusively for signal: emerald for gain, rose for loss, amber for expiring, indigo for act here. When those colors appear they carry weight precisely because they're absent everywhere else.

This is not a social product and not a motivational tool. No sharing affordances, no streak counters, no animated celebrations. The emotional register is composed, not congratulatory.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-on-white surfaces with a cool barely-tinted canvas; card-first page composition
Plus Jakarta Sans extrabold for all financial figures and section titles; Inter for everything else
Semantic-only color — the neutral ink family carries 90% of the text surface
Ambient two-layer shadow separates surfaces; cards use hairline border + soft diffuse shadow as the base register
Mobile-first: frosted-glass bottom nav; fixed sidebar on desktop

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Precision Indigo appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its scarcity is the signal. No indigo surface fills, no gradients, no large indigo text blocks.

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Gain, loss, and warn are financial semantics, not UI semantics. Do not use them for generic success/caution states.

rules.name: The Asset Accent Rule
rules.body: Asset accent colors are chart and icon colors only. Tint at 11% via color-mix for icon containers. Never as dominant surface fills.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that might change uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums via .tnum. No exceptions on financial data.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans for scale (display, headlines, titles). Inter for everything else. No third typeface.

rules.name: The Contained Lift Rule
rules.body: shadow-lift is an affordance signal, not decoration. Interactive cards hover with the heavier shadow. Non-interactive surfaces stay at shadow-soft.

dos: Do use tabular-nums (.tnum) on every number that could change — balances, percentages, counts.
Do keep Precision Indigo to ≤10% of any screen surface.
Do use shadow-soft as the default card state and shadow-lift only in response to user interaction.
Do add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to every keyframe animation.
Do scope asset accent colors to icon backgrounds and chart segments only, tinted at 11% via color-mix.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans for hero and section titles, and Inter for body, label, and metadata text.
donts: Don't use Precision Indigo as a surface fill, gradient, or large text block.
Don't introduce the Robinhood / crypto-app pattern: no price tickers, no dopamine flashes, no confetti on portfolio gains.
Don't add a third typeface. Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter is the complete vocabulary.
Don't use border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient fill).
Don't place a card inside another card.
Don't use gain/loss/warn semantic colors outside their financial contexts.
Don't round cards, modals, or inputs beyond their defined radii (cards 24px, modals 28px, inputs 12px).
